title: Pick the checkpoint automatically by suite agreement
body: A run saves a checkpoint every 250 steps; too early the face is not learned, too late the LoRA overfits. Today the owner picks by eye, helped by a likeness score on two preview scenes. Instead, generate the suite with each saved checkpoint and pick the one with the highest face agreement, minus a penalty for leakage, among those above the likeness floor. It works if the automatic choice comes within 0.01 agreement of the best checkpoint picked by hand in most runs.
